_comment: Settings > Accessibility (views only, never read by the sim, not in the online data hash). teams: the colour sets every team marker reads through Accessibility.side_color / rel_color / brawl_color; colour_safe follows Okabe & Ito (2008), 'Color Universal Design', the palette Wong (2011, Nature Methods 8:441) recommends: vermillion against sky blue, which differ in hue under protanopia, deuteranopia and tritanopia and in lightness as well. outlines: the ring round each fighter's silhouette. hit_markers: hit sparks, damage numbers and the struck fighter's flash; 'default' is the game as it always looked.
